select
    session_id,
    user_id,
    profile_id,
    lower(device_type)                                    as device_type,
    device_os,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    TIMESTAMP_DIFF(session_end, session_start, SECOND)    as session_duration_sec,
    network_type,
    upper(country)                                        as country_code,
    DATE(session_start)                                   as session_date,
    EXTRACT(hour FROM session_start)                      as session_hour,
    session_start                                         as _loaded_at
from `streaming-media-498412`.`raw`.`raw_sessions`

select
    title_id,
    title_name,
    lower(content_type)                                   as content_type,
    series_id,
    season_number,
    episode_number,
    genres,
    SPLIT(genres, ',')[SAFE_OFFSET(0)]                    as primary_genre,
    primary_language,
    release_year,
    runtime_minutes,
    is_original,
    licence_start_date,
    licence_end_date,
    case when licence_end_date < CURRENT_DATE() then false else true end as is_currently_licensed,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    created_at                                            as _loaded_at
from `streaming-media-498412`.`raw`.`raw_titles`

select
    rating_id,
    user_id,
    title_id,
    rating,
    rated_at,
    DATE(rated_at)                as rated_date,
    (rating - 0.5) / 4.5          as rating_normalized,
    rated_at                      as _loaded_at
from `streaming-media-498412`.`raw`.`raw_ratings`

select
    user_id,
    lower(trim(email))                                    as email,
    upper(country)                                        as country_code,
    lower(plan_tier)                                      as plan_tier,
    signup_date,
    is_active,
    age_band,
    profile_count,
    preferred_language,
    DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), signup_date, DAY)           as tenure_days,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    created_at                                            as _loaded_at
from `streaming-media-498412`.`raw`.`raw_users`

select
    view_event_id,
    session_id,
    user_id,
    title_id,
    lower(event_type)                                     as event_type,
    event_timestamp,
    DATE(event_timestamp)                                 as event_date,
    playback_position_sec,
    quality_level,
    coalesce(buffering_seconds, 0)                        as buffering_seconds,
    payload.device                                        as device,
    payload.network                                       as network,
    payload                                               as payload_json,
    case when event_type = 'complete'  then true else false end as is_complete,
    case when event_type = 'abandon'   then true else false end as is_abandon,
    event_timestamp                                       as _loaded_at
from `streaming-media-498412`.`raw`.`raw_view_events`

with date_spine as (
    





with rawdata as (

    

    

    with p as (
        select 0 as generated_number union all select 1
    ), unioned as (

    select

    
    p0.generated_number * power(2, 0)
     + 
    
    p1.generated_number * power(2, 1)
     + 
    
    p2.generated_number * power(2, 2)
     + 
    
    p3.generated_number * power(2, 3)
     + 
    
    p4.generated_number * power(2, 4)
     + 
    
    p5.generated_number * power(2, 5)
     + 
    
    p6.generated_number * power(2, 6)
     + 
    
    p7.generated_number * power(2, 7)
     + 
    
    p8.generated_number * power(2, 8)
    
    
    + 1
    as generated_number

    from

    
    p as p0
     cross join 
    
    p as p1
     cross join 
    
    p as p2
     cross join 
    
    p as p3
     cross join 
    
    p as p4
     cross join 
    
    p as p5
     cross join 
    
    p as p6
     cross join 
    
    p as p7
     cross join 
    
    p as p8
    
    

    )

    select *
    from unioned
    where generated_number <= 486
    order by generated_number



),

all_periods as (

    select (
        

        datetime_add(
            cast( cast('2025-09-01' as date) as datetime),
        interval row_number() over (order by 1) - 1 day
        )


    ) as date_day
    from rawdata

),

filtered as (

    select *
    from all_periods
    where date_day <= cast('2026-12-31' as date)

)

select * from filtered


)

select
    date_day,
    to_hex(md5(cast(coalesce(cast(date_day as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as string)))        as date_sk,
    EXTRACT(year    FROM date_day)                              as year_number,
    EXTRACT(quarter FROM date_day)                              as quarter_number,
    EXTRACT(month   FROM date_day)                              as month_number,
    -- BigQuery: FORMAT_DATE for month/day names
    FORMAT_DATE('%B', date_day)                                 as month_name,
    EXTRACT(isoweek FROM date_day)                              as iso_week_number,
    EXTRACT(day     FROM date_day)                              as day_of_month,
    FORMAT_DATE('%A', date_day)                                 as day_name,
    -- BigQuery DAYOFWEEK: 1=Sunday … 7=Saturday
    EXTRACT(dayofweek FROM date_day)                            as day_of_week_number,
    case when EXTRACT(dayofweek FROM date_day) in (1, 7) then true else false end as is_weekend
from date_spine

select
    to_hex(md5(cast(coalesce(cast(title_id as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as string)))  as title_sk,

    title_name,

with snap as (select * from `streaming-media-498412`.`snapshots`.`users_snapshot`)

select
    to_hex(md5(cast(coalesce(cast(user_id as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(dbt_valid_from as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as string))) as user_sk,

             CAST('9999-12-31' AS TIMESTAMP)) as valid_to,
    case when dbt_valid_to is null then true else false end as is_current
from snap

with v as (select * from `streaming-media-498412`.`dbt_dev_staging`.`stg_view_events`),
     t as (select * from `streaming-media-498412`.`dbt_dev_staging`.`stg_titles`)

select
    t.primary_genre,
    t.content_type,
    count(distinct v.user_id)                                   as unique_viewers,
    count(*)                                                    as total_events,
    sum(case when v.event_type = 'play'     then 1 else 0 end)  as plays,
    sum(case when v.event_type = 'complete' then 1 else 0 end)  as completes,
    sum(case when v.event_type = 'abandon'  then 1 else 0 end)  as abandons,
    
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(sum(case when v.event_type = 'play' then 1 else 0 end), 0) = 0 OR NULLIF(sum(case when v.event_type = 'play' then 1 else 0 end), 0) IS NULL
         THEN NULL
         ELSE SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(sum(case when v.event_type = 'complete' then 1 else 0 end) AS FLOAT64), CAST(NULLIF(sum(case when v.event_type = 'play' then 1 else 0 end), 0) AS FLOAT64))
    END
 as completion_rate,
    
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(sum(case when v.event_type = 'play' then 1 else 0 end), 0) = 0 OR NULLIF(sum(case when v.event_type = 'play' then 1 else 0 end), 0) IS NULL
         THEN NULL
         ELSE SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(sum(case when v.event_type = 'abandon'  then 1 else 0 end) AS FLOAT64), CAST(NULLIF(sum(case when v.event_type = 'play' then 1 else 0 end), 0) AS FLOAT64))
    END
 as abandon_rate
from t
left join v on t.title_id = v.title_id
group by 1, 2
order by 4 desc nulls last

with  __dbt__cte__int_content_popularity as (


with v as (select * from `streaming-media-498412`.`dbt_dev_staging`.`stg_view_events`),
     r as (select * from `streaming-media-498412`.`dbt_dev_staging`.`stg_ratings`)

select
    t.title_id,
    t.title_name,
    t.content_type,
    t.primary_genre,
    t.primary_language,
    t.release_year,
    count(distinct v.user_id)                                   as unique_viewers,
    count(*)                                                    as total_view_events,
    sum(case when v.event_type = 'complete' then 1 else 0 end)  as completes,
    sum(case when v.event_type = 'abandon'  then 1 else 0 end)  as abandons,
    
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(sum(case when v.event_type = 'play' then 1 else 0 end), 0) = 0 OR NULLIF(sum(case when v.event_type = 'play' then 1 else 0 end), 0) IS NULL
         THEN NULL
         ELSE SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(sum(case when v.event_type = 'complete' then 1 else 0 end) AS FLOAT64), CAST(NULLIF(sum(case when v.event_type = 'play' then 1 else 0 end), 0) AS FLOAT64))
    END
 as completion_rate,
    avg(r.rating)                                               as avg_rating,
    count(distinct r.rating_id)                                 as ratings_count
from `streaming-media-498412`.`dbt_dev_staging`.`stg_titles` t
left join v on t.title_id = v.title_id
left join r on t.title_id = r.title_id
group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
), c as (select * from __dbt__cte__int_content_popularity)

select
    title_id,
    title_name,
    content_type,
    primary_genre,
    primary_language,
    release_year,
    coalesce(unique_viewers,    0) as unique_viewers,
    coalesce(total_view_events, 0) as total_view_events,
    coalesce(completes,         0) as completes,
    coalesce(abandons,          0) as abandons,
    coalesce(completion_rate,   0) as completion_rate,
    avg_rating,
    coalesce(ratings_count,     0) as ratings_count,
    -- Bayesian-adjusted rating: shrink toward global mean for low-count titles
    case
        when ratings_count is null or ratings_count = 0 then null
        else (coalesce(ratings_count, 0) * coalesce(avg_rating, 0)
              + 100 * 3.5)           -- prior: 100 ratings of 3.5
             / (coalesce(ratings_count, 0) + 100)
    end                             as bayesian_rating,
    case
        when unique_viewers >= 5000 then 'hit'
        when unique_viewers >= 1000 then 'popular'
        when unique_viewers >=  100 then 'modest'
        else 'niche'
    end                             as performance_band
from c
order by unique_viewers desc nulls last

with src as (
    select * from `streaming-media-498412`.`dbt_dev_staging`.`stg_view_events`
),
dim_u as (
    select user_sk, user_business_key, valid_from, valid_to
    from `streaming-media-498412`.`dbt_dev_marts`.`dim_user_scd2`
)
select
    s.view_event_id,
    s.session_id,
    u.user_sk,
    s.user_id                                                  as user_business_key,
    to_hex(md5(cast(coalesce(cast(s.title_id as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as string)))     as title_sk,
    s.title_id                                                 as title_business_key,
    to_hex(md5(cast(coalesce(cast(s.event_date as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as string)))   as date_sk,
    s.event_type,
    s.event_timestamp,
    s.event_date,
    s.playback_position_sec,
    s.quality_level,
    s.buffering_seconds,
    s.device,
    s.network,
    s.is_complete,
    s.is_abandon,
    s._loaded_at,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()                                        as _dbt_inserted_at
from src s
left join dim_u u
       on s.user_id        = u.user_business_key
      and s.event_timestamp >= CAST(u.valid_from AS TIMESTAMP)
      and s.event_timestamp <  CAST(u.valid_to   AS TIMESTAMP)

with  __dbt__cte__int_user_engagement as (


with v as (select * from `streaming-media-498412`.`dbt_dev_staging`.`stg_view_events`),
     s as (select * from `streaming-media-498412`.`dbt_dev_staging`.`stg_sessions`),
     r as (select * from `streaming-media-498412`.`dbt_dev_staging`.`stg_ratings`)

select
    u.user_id                                                   as user_id,
    count(distinct s.session_id)                                as total_sessions,
    sum(s.session_duration_sec) / 60.0                          as total_watch_minutes,
    count(distinct v.title_id)                                  as unique_titles_watched,
    sum(case when v.event_type = 'complete' then 1 else 0 end)  as titles_completed,
    sum(case when v.event_type = 'abandon'  then 1 else 0 end)  as titles_abandoned,
    
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(sum(case when v.event_type = 'play' then 1 else 0 end), 0) = 0 OR NULLIF(sum(case when v.event_type = 'play' then 1 else 0 end), 0) IS NULL
         THEN NULL
         ELSE SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(sum(case when v.event_type = 'complete' then 1 else 0 end) AS FLOAT64), CAST(NULLIF(sum(case when v.event_type = 'play' then 1 else 0 end), 0) AS FLOAT64))
    END
 as completion_rate,
    count(distinct r.rating_id)                                 as ratings_given,
    avg(r.rating)                                               as avg_rating_given,
    max(s.session_start)                                        as last_session_at,
    -- BigQuery: DATE_DIFF on DATE values
    DATE_DIFF(
        CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE),
        DATE(max(s.session_start)),
        DAY
    )                                                           as days_since_last_session
from `streaming-media-498412`.`dbt_dev_staging`.`stg_users` u
left join s on u.user_id = s.user_id
left join v on u.user_id = v.user_id
left join r on u.user_id = r.user_id
group by u.user_id
), u as (select * from `streaming-media-498412`.`dbt_dev_staging`.`stg_users`),
     e as (select * from __dbt__cte__int_user_engagement)

select
    u.user_id,
    u.email,
    u.country_code,
    u.plan_tier,
    u.tenure_days,
    coalesce(e.total_sessions,          0) as total_sessions,
    coalesce(e.total_watch_minutes,     0) as total_watch_minutes,
    coalesce(e.unique_titles_watched,   0) as unique_titles_watched,
    coalesce(e.titles_completed,        0) as titles_completed,
    coalesce(e.titles_abandoned,        0) as titles_abandoned,
    coalesce(e.completion_rate,         0) as completion_rate,
    coalesce(e.ratings_given,           0) as ratings_given,
    e.avg_rating_given,
    e.last_session_at,
    coalesce(e.days_since_last_session, 9999) as days_since_last_session,
    case
        when e.days_since_last_session is null then 'never_active'
        when e.days_since_last_session <=   7  then 'weekly_active'
        when e.days_since_last_session <=  30  then 'monthly_active'
        when e.days_since_last_session <=  90  then 'lapsed'
        else 'churned'
    end                                    as activity_band
from u
left join e on u.user_id = e.user_id
